goal: Speed up wallet fast rescans by parallelizing compact block filter checks across CPU cores
Reduce wallet rescan and restoration times from minutes to seconds on multi-core systems
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review
agreement: Strong support with benchmarks confirming 3x to 6x rescan speedups (ismaelsadeeq, l0rinc)
Strong concept approval after addressing cross-wallet thread pool contention (rkrux)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, polespinasa)
Prior objections about non-SSD disk seeking and worker starvation were resolved (luke-jr, bvbfan)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it yields a 4.5x to nearly 8x speedup for wallet fast rescans on multi-core systems
P2 because scanning 200,000 blocks drops from over 4.5 minutes to under 35 seconds with 8 threads
